rationale: The tool-call sequence shows the agent looked up the user and order, then executed modify_pending_order_address without any explicit user confirmation step. Policy requires confirming every order-changing action before taking it. There is also no visible verification that the order belongs to the authenticated user or that it is pending, and the address fields (e.g., 123 Elm Street) appear assumed without shown support from tool results. No final confirmation back to the user is evident. Therefore, the interaction does not meet the pass bar.
